manifest_row.title: Booming Front Range cities take first steps to build $500 million dam, reservoir near Holy Cross Wilderness

screening.main_topic: A proposed reservoir in Colorado’s Holy Cross Wilderness and the conflict between urban water demand, wetlands protection, and natural water storage.
screening.climate_relevance: The article discusses climate warming, earlier snowmelt, drought, increasing aridity, and uncertainty in Colorado River Basin water supplies. These climate impacts are directly tied to the debate over whether more reservoirs are needed or whether natural wetlands provide more resilient water storage.
screening.reason: Although the proposed dam and its environmental consequences are the main focus, climate change meaningfully shapes the article’s account of water scarcity, supply planning, and competing adaptation strategies.
